Following previous works, we will use token-level F1 and accuracy for the rationalization and downstream performance. In our result tables, we define S as the sparsity level of selected rationales, computed using the formula S = #selected tokens #tokens . P, R, and F1 represent precision, recall, and F1 score for rationale extraction, respectively. ACC and Val ACC denote the accuracy of the test and validation sets, respectively.
